description: Figure 3 illustrates the relationship between inter-annotator agreement and two measures of ambiguity: sample-level standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity. The horizontal axis represents ambiguity, with “Ambiguity Std” and “Ambiguity Max” as categories, each further divided into “Inner” and “Outer” subcategories, and is labeled with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 3. The vertical axis represents “Pair Kappa,” labeled with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. There are four bars displayed, each representing a combination of ambiguity measure and level. The “Ambiguity Std Inner” bar is light blue and extends to approximately 0.46. The “Ambiguity Std Outer” bar is dark blue and extends to approximately 0.23. The “Ambiguity Max Inner” bar is light orange and extends to approximately 0.94. The “Ambiguity Max Outer” bar is dark orange and extends to approximately 0.46.  Each bar is labeled with its corresponding Kappa value above it. The bars are arranged in order of increasing ambiguity standard deviation and maximum ambiguity, with “Inner” bars appearing before “Outer” bars for each ambiguity measure.
